Definition: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
BiblicalUsage: 1) palace, temple, nave, sanctuary; 1a) palace; 1b) temple (palace of God as king); 1c) hall, nave (of Ezekiel's temple); 1d) temple (of heavenly temple)
